scenario: Real associated WebContent process termination before evaluator correction
observed: Native host aborted (EXC_CRASH/SIGABRT) after an unhandled NSErrorException escaped MAUI async-void JavaScript evaluation. Native recovery alert unavailable; XCTest activation relaunched a fresh process, which is not successful recovery.

root_cause.explanation: MapEvaluateJavaScriptAsync is async void and awaits the faulted inner request without catching it before settling the outer request. Caller try/catch cannot intercept this main-thread exception.
